summary: Allow Users to Merge Potential Duplicate Records

description.raw: GIVEN I encounter potential duplicates of a particular record WHEN I confirm that they are in fact duplicates AND i do not want to create a new duplicate record THEN I should have the option of merging the information between two records to make them one This should apply to all records within all objects Duplication rules can remain as-is
